_meta.captured_by: coordinator (acting lead; plan-reviewer + builder were startup-stalled/dead)
_meta.contract: detector reads state['retrieval_trace'] (Slice B) + state['retrieval_succeeded'] (protected, read-only) and writes state['retrieval_grade'] in {strong,low_confidence,empty}, state['retrieval_grade_reasons']=list[str] (triggered conditions only), state['should_requery']=bool. It MUST NOT mutate the 4 protected Slice-B keys (filtered_documents, documents, is_rag_augmented, retrieval_succeeded).

signal_mapping.ce_confidence: retrieval_trace['ce_confidence'] (float|None; normalized CE discrimination in [0,1]). Rule inactive when None (reranker off/failed).
signal_mapping.top1_rerank_score: retrieval_trace['candidates'][0]['ce_score'] (real cross-encoder score; NOT 'score' which is RRF-scale). Rule inactive when candidates empty or ce_score None.
signal_mapping.top1_top2_margin: candidates[0]['ce_score'] - candidates[1]['ce_score']. Rule inactive when <2 candidates or either ce_score None.
signal_mapping.concept_coverage: DEFERRED v1 — not computable from retrieval_trace (per-candidate concept sets not persisted; adding them needs forbidden Slice-B edits). TAU_COVERAGE reserved, rule inactive.

_meta.ce_confidence_none_policy: team-lead ruling 3(b): ce_confidence None (reranker off/failed) is treated as a WEAK signal -> low_confidence with reason 'ce_confidence=None(untrustworthy)'. It does NOT arm should_requery (a re-query cannot restore a reranker that did not run; Slice D owns requery guards).
_meta.grade_rules: empty iff (retrieval_trace absent) OR (not retrieval_succeeded); else low_confidence iff any active low-confidence rule fires; else strong.
_meta.should_requery_rule: True iff grade==low_confidence AND ce_confidence was PRESENT and < TAU_CONF (a computed-low confidence); else False (None-confidence, top1/margin-only, empty, and strong never requery in v1).

cases.name: G1_strong
cases.description: High confidence, high top1, wide margin -> strong, no reasons, no requery.

cases.name: G2_low_conf_ce_confidence_only
cases.description: Only ce_confidence below tau -> low_confidence, requery TRUE.

cases.name: G3_low_conf_top1_only
cases.description: Only top1 rerank score below tau (margin ok, confidence ok) -> low_confidence, requery FALSE.

cases.name: G4_low_conf_margin_only
cases.description: Only top1-top2 margin below tau -> low_confidence, requery FALSE.

cases.name: G5_multi_trigger_requery
cases.description: ce_confidence + top1 + margin all fire -> low_confidence, requery TRUE (order: ce_confidence, top1_rerank_score, top1_top2_margin).

cases.name: G7_empty_trace_absent
cases.description: retrieval_trace key absent (retrieval node raised -> dispatcher popped trace) -> empty, requery FALSE.

cases.name: G8_reranker_inactive_untrustworthy
cases.description: Reranker off/failed: ce_confidence None + ce_score None. Ruling 3(b): None is untrustworthy -> low_confidence with 'ce_confidence=None(untrustworthy)'. should_requery FALSE (a re-query cannot restore a missing reranker).

cases.name: G9_single_candidate
cases.description: Exactly one candidate: top1 rule active, margin rule skipped (needs >=2) -> low_confidence on top1, requery FALSE.

cases.name: G10_real_b01_shape
cases.description: Mirrors real frozen B01-001 (ce_confidence=0.0, top1=top2 ce_score=0.0024643 -> margin 0). All three rules fire -> low_confidence, requery TRUE.

cases.name: G11_definitions_only_no_ranked_candidates
cases.description: Reachable definitions-only retrieval: succeeded True (docs from injected definitions) but candidates==[] (RRF empty). -> low_confidence 'no_ranked_candidates', requery FALSE. Guards against grading a zero-ranked-clause retrieval 'strong' (reviewer defect #1).
